components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default high-intent action, backed by theme primary tokens.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; white-space: nowrap; border: 1px solid var(--color-primary); border-radius: 1rem; background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-on-primary); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.025em; transition: opacity 0.2s ease, outline-offset 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.75; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 1; outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A supporting action with the secondary theme role.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; white-space: nowrap; border: 1px solid var(--color-secondary); border-radius: 1rem; background: var(--color-secondary); color: var(--color-on-secondary); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.025em; transition: opacity 0.2s ease, outline-offset 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { opacity: 0.75; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-secondary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { opacity: 1; outline-offset: 0; }

components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid var(--color-outline); border-radius: var(--radius-radius); background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-on-surface); padding: 1.5rem; font-family: var(--font-body); transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--color-primary); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0.5rem 0; color: var(--color-on-surface-strong); font-family: var(--font-title); font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 700; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--color-on-surface); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.625; } .ds-card-tag { display: inline-flex; width: fit-content; border-radius: var(--radius-radius); background: var(--color-surface-alt); color: var(--color-on-surface-strong); padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A compact field with visible label, outline border, and theme-aware focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.375rem; color: var(--color-on-surface-strong); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--color-outline); border-radius: var(--radius-radius); background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-on-surface); padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font: inherit; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, outline-offset 0.2s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-on-surface-muted); opacity: 1; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--color-outline-strong); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: var(--color-primary); }

components.name: Primary Badge
components.description: A compact status label for theme-aware metadata and state.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; width: fit-content; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; border-radius: var(--radius-radius); background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-on-primary); padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1; font-weight: 500; } .ds-badge:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Result Row
components.description: A dense command row with neutral active state and primary match highlight.
components.css: .ds-search-row { display: flex; width: 100%; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-on-surface); padding: 1rem; text-align: left; font-family: var(--font-body); transition: background-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-search-row:hover, .ds-search-row:focus-visible { background: var(--color-surface-alt); color: var(--color-on-surface-strong); outline: none; } .ds-search-row[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--color-surface-alt); box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--color-outline-strong); color: var(--color-on-surface-strong); } .ds-search-title { font-family: var(--font-title); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-search-desc { font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-search-row mark { background: transparent; color: var(--color-primary); font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: A predictable docs navigation row with tonal hover and structural active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; border-radius: var(--radius-radius); color: var(--color-on-surface); padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { background: var(--color-surface-alt); color: var(--color-on-surface-strong); outline: none; } .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--color-surface-alt); color: var(--color-on-surface-strong); box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--color-outline-strong); }

narrative.northStar: The Go Workbench at the Beach
narrative.overview:
Goshtoso should feel like a real workbench for Go developers: sturdy, typed, inspectable, and ready for application UI. The beach signal comes from the Copacabana mascot and the warmer theme personality, but it should appear as confidence and memorability, not as decoration pasted over technical docs.

The system is theme-first. Surfaces, accents, text, borders, feedback states, and radius all flow through CSS custom properties so demos, examples, and consumer apps can change clothes without changing component contracts. The default stance is practical density: predictable navigation, visible examples, compact API tables, and clear component states.

This design explicitly rejects generic SaaS landing pages, CDN-snippet galleries, interchangeable icon-card catalogs, glossy framework marketing, and AI-looking patterns unrelated to the Go-first product.
keyCharacteristics: Token-driven themes with light and dark parity.
Server-rendered examples that use the real component library.
Rounded, friendly controls balanced by dense documentation layouts.
Primary accent as an interaction signal, not a decorative wash.
Accessibility visible through focus states, contrast checks, and reduced-motion fallbacks.

rules.name: The Token First Rule
rules.body: Use semantic color roles in components. Do not hardcode one theme's palette into reusable UI.

rules.name: The Accent Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Primary is for action, active state, and orientation. If every heading is primary, no element is primary.

rules.name: The Contrast Is Product Rule
rules.body: State and muted text must clear AA contrast across themes; opacity-as-hierarchy is forbidden for body copy.

rules.name: The Literal Label Rule
rules.body: Buttons and links say what happens: "Save changes", "Browse components", "View docs". Avoid clever CTA language.

rules.name: The Code Is Evidence Rule
rules.body: Use mono for code identifiers and snippets, not as lazy technical atmosphere.

rules.name: The Flat By Default Rule
rules.body: Cards, docs panels, and component demos rest on borders and tonal contrast. If a shadow is visible at rest, it must explain a layering relationship.

dos: Do compose public pages from real Goshtoso components whenever possible.
Do keep every component themeable through semantic `var(--color-*)` and `var(--radius-radius)` roles.
Do verify light mode, dark mode, the Goshtoso theme, and the Minimal theme before shipping a visual change.
Do use examples, fragments, and live component states to explain the server-rendered model.
Do preserve WCAG AA contrast, visible focus, keyboard paths, and reduced-motion fallbacks.
donts: Don't make Goshtoso look like a generic SaaS landing page.
Don't make it feel like a CDN-snippet gallery or a component catalog made from interchangeable icon cards.
Don't use glossy framework marketing, vague productivity claims, or decorative AI-looking patterns unrelated to the Go-first product.
Don't let the Copacabana gopher personality become a gimmick that overwhelms technical trust.
Don't hand-code one theme's values into reusable components; token drift is a product bug.
